name: answer-review
summary: Answer the open review threads of one pull request of Cloving that no run owns: fix what a comment asks for, reply once to each thread, and resolve a thread only when its rule allows it.

points.question: When does the workflow resolve a review thread?

options.label: Resolve bot threads after a fix
options.summary: Resolve a thread of a bot after its fix is pushed. Never resolve a thread of a person: that person resolves it.
options.change: Keep resolveAfterFix as resolveThread from answer-review/resolve.ts in answer-review/replies.ts. Keep selection.resolve as bot-fix in answer-review/scenarios.ts.

options.label: Never resolve
options.summary: Reply to each thread and leave every thread open for its author.
options.change: In answer-review/replies.ts replace resolveAfterFix as resolveThread with neverResolve as resolveThread in the answer-review/resolve.ts import. Set selection.resolve to never in answer-review/scenarios.ts.
